Language models usually predict one toke.src:
Language models usually predict one token at a time, left to right.
              Diffusion models take a different path: start with noise, and iteratively
              refine the whole sequence at once.

@@T0@@Why this matters.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@为何这很重要。@@T1@@
          面向文本的离散扩散是一个活跃的研究领域（MDLM、SEDD、UDLM）。其核心思想简单到足以放进一个浏览器演示中。本页构建了最小的可用版本：一个作用于定长字符序列的掩码扩散模型。我们将用 40 个印度人名训练它，并观察它学会生成新名字。
@@T0@@Why this matters.@@T1@@\n.src: Why this matters. Discrete diffusion for text is an active research area (MDLM, SEDD, UDLM). The core idea is simple enough to fit in a browser demo. This page builds the smallest useful version: a mask-diffusion model on fixed-length character sequences. We will train it on 40 Indian names and watch it learn to generate new ones.

@@T0@@II.@@T1@@ How corruption dissolves.zh: @@T0@@II.@@T1@@ 破坏过程如何消解一个名字
@@T0@@II.@@T1@@ How corruption dissolves.src: II. How corruption dissolves a name

The forward corruption process is dead s.zh: 前向破坏过程极其简单。给定一个像 @@T0@@priya@@T1@@ 这样的干净名字，将其填充到固定长度，并以概率 @@T4@@t@@T5@@ 独立地将每个字符替换为掩码词元 @@T2@@?@@T3@@。当 @@T6@@t = 0@@T7@@ 时名字保持不变。当 @@T8@@t = 1@@T9@@ 时每个字符都被掩蔽，所有信息都被破坏。
The forward corruption process is dead s.src: The forward corruption process is dead simple. Given a clean name like priya, pad it to a fixed length and replace each character with a mask token ? independently with probability t. At t = 0 the name is untouched. At t = 1 every character is masked and all information is destroyed.

This is the discrete analogue of adding.zh: 这是图像扩散中加入高斯噪声的离散类比物。我们不模糊像素值，而是擦除字符。噪声水平 @@T0@@t@@T1@@ 与扩散时间步扮演相同的角色：它控制模型可以依据的信息量。
This is the discrete analogue of adding.src: This is the discrete analogue of adding Gaussian noise in image diffusion. Instead of blurring pixel values, we erase characters. The noise level t plays the same role as the diffusion timestep: it controls how much information the model gets to work with.

Slide the noise level to watch character.zh: 滑动噪声水平，观察字符如何消解为掩码。每个名字使用固定的随机顺序，因此拖动时揭示过程是平滑的。右侧的小图是 @@T0@@日程曲线@@T1@@：被掩蔽词元所占比例随 @@T2@@t@@T3@@ 线性上升，而模型所保留的信息则逐渐减少。注意像 @@T4@@dev@@T5@@ 这样的短名字，比 @@T6@@reyansh@@T7@@ 这样的长名字更快地丢失全部信息。
Slide the noise level to watch character.src: Slide the noise level to watch characters dissolve into masks. Each name uses a fixed random order so the reveal is smooth as you drag. The mini-chart on the right is the schedule: the fraction of tokens masked rises linearly with t while the information the model keeps falls away. Notice how short names like dev lose all information faster than long ones like reyansh.

@@T0@@Discrete vs. continuous.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@离散与连续。@@T1@@
          在连续（高斯）扩散中 —— 即用于图像的那一类 —— 破坏过程将每个取值向随机噪声方向偏移一部分，如 $x_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,\varepsilon$，是一种平滑的模糊；而在这里，破坏过程对每个词元而言都是一次全有或全无的抛硬币（$\texttt{keep}$ 或 $\texttt{[MASK]}$），因此一个词元要么完好无损，要么彻底消失。
@@T0@@Discrete vs. continuous.@@T1@@\n.src: Discrete vs. continuous. In continuous (Gaussian) diffusion — the kind used for images — corruption slides each value part-way toward random noise as $x_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,\varepsilon$, a smooth blur; here corruption is an all-or-nothing coin flip per token ($\texttt{keep}$ or $\texttt{[MASK]}$), so a token is either perfectly intact or completely gone.

The model is a plain two-layer MLP &mdas.zh: 该模型是一个普通的两层 MLP —— 没有注意力机制，也没有循环结构。它一次性看到全部位置，并并行地预测它们。词表共有 22 个符号：名字中出现的 20 个字母，外加一个填充词元 @@T0@@_@@T1@@ 和一个掩码词元 @@T2@@?@@T3@@。
The model is a plain two-layer MLP &mdas.src: The model is a plain two-layer MLP — no attention, no recurrence. It sees all positions at once and predicts them all in parallel. The vocabulary has 22 symbols: 20 letters that appear in the names, plus a padding token _ and a mask token ?.

The loss is cross-entropy averaged over.zh: 损失函数是在所有位置上取平均的交叉熵。模型必须预测原始名字的每一个字符 —— 无论该位置是否被掩蔽。它能看到的位置提供容易的信号；被掩蔽的位置则逼迫它进行真正的学习。通过 @@T0@@t@@T1@@ 进行的时间条件化告诉模型输入有多嘈杂，使其能够相应地校准置信度。
The loss is cross-entropy averaged over.src: The loss is cross-entropy averaged over all positions. The model must predict every character of the original name — whether that position was masked or not. Positions it can see give easy signal; masked positions force real learning. Time conditioning via t tells the model how noisy the input is, so it can calibrate its confidence accordingly.

During training, each step picks a rando.zh: 训练期间，每一步随机选取一个名字、一个随机噪声水平 @@T0@@t ~ Uniform(0, 1)@@T1@@，破坏该名字，并反向传播预测误差。随着时间推移，模型学会了印度人名的结构 —— 常见的字符模式、典型的长度、元音与辅音倾向于出现的位置。
During training, each step picks a rando.src: During training, each step picks a random name, a random noise level t ~ Uniform(0, 1), corrupts the name, and backpropagates the prediction error. Over time the model learns the structure of Indian names — common character patterns, typical lengths, where vowels and consonants tend to fall.

@@T0@@From toy to real.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@从玩具到真实。@@T1@@
          这一思想的真实版本（MDLM、SEDD、Plaid）使用 Transformer、可变长度以及大得多的词表。但你刚刚看到的机制 —— 掩蔽、预测、揭示 —— 正是其核心所在。关键洞见在于，要获得扩散式的生成，你并不需要高斯扩散或连续嵌入。离散掩蔽就已足够。
@@T0@@From toy to real.@@T1@@\n.src: From toy to real. The real versions of this idea (MDLM, SEDD, Plaid) use transformers, variable lengths, and much larger vocabularies. But the mechanism you just saw — mask, predict, reveal — is the same one at the core. The key insight is that you do not need Gaussian diffusion or continuous embeddings to get diffusion-style generation. Discrete masking is enough.

The name generator creates sequences fro.zh: 名字生成器从无到有地创建序列 —— 这是无条件生成。但扩散也能进行 @@T0@@条件生成@@T1@@：给定一个问题，产出答案。唯一的变化在于对什么进行掩蔽。
The name generator creates sequences fro.src: The name generator creates sequences from nothing — unconditional generation. But diffusion can also do conditional generation: given a question, produce the answer. The only change is what gets masked.

Unconditional vs conditional diffusion.zh: 无条件扩散与条件扩散对比

This model memorizes 40 names &mdash; th.zh: 该模型记住了 40 个名字 —— 这是有意为之。重点不在泛化，而在机制：观察破坏日程、去噪预测与迭代揭示如何协同，产生一个从根本上不同于自回归预测的生成模型。

This model memorizes 40 names — that is by design. The point is not
          generalization but mechanism: seeing the corruption schedule, the denoising prediction,
          and the iterative reveal work together to produce a generative model that is
          fundamentally different from autoregressive prediction.

meta.title: 微型文本扩散模型
meta.tagline: 掩蔽、预测、揭示 —— 扩散模型如何在不从左到右的前提下生成文本
meta.summary: 一篇动手实践的讲解，在你的浏览器中用印度人名训练一个离散去噪扩散模型，展示迭代式解除掩蔽如何在不逐词元预测的情况下生成文本。
highlights: 通过一个具体的并排示例，理解自回归生成与扩散式并行预测的差异。
滑动噪声水平，观察印度人名如何消解为掩码、又如何复原。
在浏览器中实时训练一个小型神经网络 —— 调整轮次与学习率，观察损失曲线下降。
通过迭代去噪生成新名字，观察字符如何从纯噪声中逐步浮现。
